 Rare video of Brazilian Amazon tribe
 A new video has emerged showing members of the isolated Awa tribe who live in the remote part of Brazil’s Amazon forest. The group ventured out of the forest and accepted food as aid workers raise concerns about the dangers posed by illegal loggers and hunters.
